channel.title: Jiahao Zhang - Research Updates
channel.description: Research publications, projects, and patents from Jiahao Zhang.

item.title: PanoTask: Task-Driven Panoramic Video Generation with Scene-Aware Autoregressive Camera Trajectory Prediction
item.description: PanoTask introduces a two-stage, task-driven pipeline for predicting scene-aware camera trajectories and synthesizing geometrically consistent panoramic videos.

item.title: MKSNet: Advanced Small Object Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery with Multi-Kernel and Dual Attention Mechanisms
item.description: MKSNet combines multi-kernel selection and dual attention mechanisms for small-object detection in remote-sensing imagery.

item.title: 一种基于多尺度Census变换的图像脉冲编码方法
item.description: 中国发明专利 CN 120088344 A：一种结合多尺度特征提取与 Census 变换的图像脉冲编码方法。
